## Section 3 — Weekly comment format

Each Monday a fresh comment is posted to the issue. Template (kept tight — comments compound fast):

```
### Week of YYYY-MM-DD — /goal picklist

Quota window resets: anthropic <DOW>, openai <DOW>, gemini <DOW>
Open-issue surface: N issues at status:plan-approved | M at status:plan-review

PICKLIST (3-5 items max)

1. [#NNNN](url) — <issue title>
   catalog: #<24-30 or 1-23> (<short pattern name>)
   runner: claude | codex | hermes | gemini
   why this week: <one line — fresh quota, blocking other work, deadline, etc.>
   gate: status:plan-approved required before /goal can run

2. ...

SKIPPED (catalog entries deliberately not picked this week)
- #<entry> — <reason: blocked, low ROI this cycle, owner busy, etc.>

NOTES
- <any non-obvious sequencing or provider allocation>
```

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The `SKIPPED` section is the secret weapon here. After 4-6 weeks of comments, the skipped log tells you which catalog entries are *aspirationally listed but never run* — strong signal to retire them from Tier 2 or rewrite them. Without explicit skip tracking, "we just never got around to it" becomes invisible noise that bloats the catalog forever.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

Key design choices baked in:
1. **Hard cap at 5 items** — picking too many guarantees nothing runs; weekly token budgets only support 3-5 multi-day /goal invocations realistically.
2. **`gate: status:plan-approved` line** — explicit reminder that `/goal` invocation is downstream of the user-in-loop planning gate per `feedback_never_offer_to_self_label_plan_approved`. Without this, the comment could be mis-read as authorization.
3. **`runner:` field** — declarative provider allocation prevents two agents racing on the same /goal in different sessions (relates to `feedback_multi_agent_commit_serialization`).
4. **Quota reset DOWs explicit** — Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini reset on different schedules; the comment surfaces this so we don't queue work the week a key provider is about to reset.
